mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as cplAgencyName, c2.C_Name as cplLiableCompanyName, dp1.D_Name as cplDeclareDepName, dp2.D_Name as cplUseDepName, mn.* from Pro_Construction_Plan_List mn left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = mn.Cpl_Agency left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = mn.Cpl_Liable_Company left join SYS_Department dp1 on dp1.D_Id = mn.Cpl_Declare_Dep left join SYS_Department dp2 on dp2.D_Id = mn.Cpl_Use_Dep where mn.Pcp_Id = #{pcpId} and (mn.Cpl_Append=false or (mn.Cpl_Append=true and mn.State=7))
select f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Pro_Construction_plan mn left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Pcp_Id where mn.Pcp_Id = #{pcpId}
select sum(Cpl_Planned_Investment) as cplPlannedInvSum from Pro_Construction_Plan_List cpl left join Pro_Construction_plan mn on mn.Pcp_Id=cpl.Pcp_Id
